title: Finish ends on a receipt: share each invite link, retry only what failed
tests_added: app/features/shell/setup/setupFinishOutcome.test.ts (+12 cases: receipt links/unshareable/null/failure-only/invite split, isRetryable x3 incl. the critic's code-less 409/404 vs 429/5xx, finishNext, mergeFinishRuns, finish() source-shape pin, tour-deferral pin, 4-catalog readyMeta copy)

app/features/shell/setup/setupOnboardingFinish.test.ts (+5 cases: token read, token-less landed, finishRemainder, retry posts only petr + the board, permanent refusal not re-run; 2 existing deepEquals updated to the token/httpStatus shape)
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: sized L; acceptance 6 split into the pure finishNext case and a source-shape pin (finish() body has no `finally`, no clearDraft( / stamp("completed"); both live in one settle() callback; finish hands the run to land(), which asks finishNext) plus a pin that the tour tile calls ctrl.finish(() => sim.start()); isRetryable takes the HTTP status and treats a code-less non-2xx from /api/org/invites as permanent unless 429/5xx. Acceptance 8 = card's 7 with 6 split. Shape choices: persistOnboardingSetup now returns SetupFinishRun {outcome, parts, invites} and takes an optional `only` parts list; finishPartsFor(state, only?) intersects. finishRemainder returns {state, parts} (not a bare state) because language/currency are written on every walked run, so a state alone cannot express 'only invites + pipeline'; it keeps only RETRYABLE failures (a permanent refusal is named, not re-run). Added mergeFinishRuns (fold a retry back without letting 'skipped' overwrite 'landed' or re-minting a token). Receipt splits refused invites into (retryable, code) groups. Write set: shrank (no setupSteps beyond OnboardingCtrl fields); copyInviteUrl is imported from settings/workspace/workspaceAdminHelpers.ts (already on the page graph) rather than re-typed. perf-budget.json (lock) raised 2 KB.
notes: Red before: 8 of 8 (both test files failed at import - no finishNext/finishReceipt/isRetryable/mergeFinishRuns/finishRemainder exports; the copy case and both source pins also red on their own). Invite links are capability links: shown only on the receipt to the inviting operator, a copy failure is toasted not logged, never in a URL or telemetry; /invite/<token> IS covered by TOKEN_PATH in instrumentation-client.ts (no edit needed). Slot A hand-off preserved: relevantSteps/seat untouched; the invite-less six-step e2e (journey-role-to-schedule) gets receipt=null -> closes as before. Behaviour note for the integrator: any failed part in a live finish now keeps the wizard open on the receipt instead of closing under a toast; a THROWN persist (a server action whose request died) still toasts partial and closes, as before. Escape on the receipt = Done. Gates: tsc exits 2 only on the untracked kpi-sim/ tree (pre-existing, same as slot A). Full test:unit exit 1 on two files: recipes-literals (mine, fixed by composing PANEL, re-run green) and app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts ('the child must have forked its grandchildren before we abort') which also fails standalone and touches nothing in this card (python-runner process-tree kill on this Windows box). test:perf: measured base 2caa4dcde + this card alone 1421/9011.8 KB -> 1422/9033.5 KB (fit); committed HEAD 93aa36bd3 measured 1423/9046.7 KB vs 1426/9045 after devcase-orchestration/B's raise, so maxKb 9045 -> 9047 (457f353b0). The live shared checkout test:perf is red on sibling builders' uncommitted route-graph files (analyze-run, billing, devcase, offer-finalize), not this card. Not verified in a browser (no dev/build per brief).
